finding: The admitted mountain-bike sources paint approximately 24 design units wide. A156 explicitly chose size 20 and paints approximately 20 units wide. Size 24 is legal in the DSL and checker-complete; it restores source-like width but remains off-keyline by warning and is not a qualified design.

causeAssessment.partSize: A156 filled uses size 20; the outlined composition was likewise assembled to 20 units. This directly causes the measured shrink.
causeAssessment.keyline: The checker does not force size 20: off-keyline size 24 is legal and produces warnings only.
causeAssessment.prompt: The prompt requests source silhouette and optical scale; it does not require the smaller size. The shrink was an authored part-size choice.
